body:
Closes #295

Bittensor's runtime passes TAO amounts to its calls as `TaoBalance`, a `u64` newtype (for example `SubtensorModule.add_stake(hotkey, netuid, amount_staked: TaoBalance)`). `TaoBalance` is not in `balanceTypes`, so `checkBalanceEncoding` leaves these values unformatted and staking 1 TAO shows `amount_staked 1000000000`. This PR adds `"TaoBalance"` to `balanceTypes`, so the value gets the decimals and unit from the metadata proof: `amount_staked TAO 1.0`.

## Change

- `app/src/metadata_parser.c`: one entry added to `balanceTypes`, formatted with the repo's `.clang-format` (clang-format 21, the version cpp-linter-action uses by default).
- `docs/format.md`: `TaoBalance` added to the list of amount types.
- `AlphaBalance` is not added on purpose: it is an amount of a subnet's alpha token, not TAO, and stays raw.
- `limit_price` is also typed `TaoBalance`, so it gets the TAO unit too:
  - `add_stake_limit`, `remove_stake_limit`, `add_collateral`: a price in rao per alpha, so `limit_price TAO 0.05` reads as 0.05 TAO per alpha.
  - `swap_stake_limit`, `move_stake_limit`: the origin/destination alpha price ratio scaled by 1e9 (the `move_stake_limit` doc says "destination-alpha per origin-alpha ratio, scaled by 1e9"; both calls go through `get_max_amount_move` in subtensor). A 0.95 ratio shows as `limit_price TAO 0.95` instead of `950000000`: the number is right but the unit is wrong. `checkBalanceEncoding` only has the field's type name (and the pallet, for `Assets`) to go on, so it can't tell these calls apart. Let me know if you want those two handled differently.
- `Option<TaoBalance>` fields (`remove_stake_full_limit.limit_price`, `add_stake_burn.limit`) still show the raw value, as `Option<BalanceOf<T>>` fields do elsewhere.

## Tests

New `tests/supported_chains/bittensor-477.json`: finney vectors (spec 477) with the same fields and layout as the existing ones (`blob = callData ++ seIncludedInExtrinsic ++ seIncludedInSignedData`, `metadata` = RFC-0078 proof, `digest` = metadata digest). They were built with bittensor-core (subtensor repo, tag `v477`) against finney's V15 metadata at block #9276924. Mortal era (period 64), nonce 7, tip 0.

| # | Call | Checks |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `Balances.transfer_keep_alive`, 1.25 TAO | already formatted before this change (`T::Balance`); regression guard |
| 1 | `SubtensorModule.add_stake`, 1 TAO | `amount_staked : TAO 1.0` |
| 2 | `SubtensorModule.add_stake_limit` | `amount_staked : TAO 1.5`, `limit_price : TAO 0.05` |
| 3 | `SubtensorModule.remove_stake` | `AlphaBalance` stays raw: `amount_unstaked : 2000000000` |
| 4 | `Utility.batch` of `add_stake` and `remove_stake` | nested calls: `TAO 0.5` and raw `250000000` |

I wrote the expected `output` / `output_expert` lines from the display rules and checked them with the C++ suite (cmake Debug build + ctest, as `make cpp_test` does) in Docker:

- `main` with the new file: 5597 passed, 6 failed (vectors 1, 2 and 4, normal and expert). The only mismatched lines are the four `TaoBalance` ones, e.g. `4 | amount_staked : 1000000000` instead of `4 | amount_staked : TAO 1.0`.
- This branch: 5603 of 5603 passed (5593 existing + 10 new).

At block #9276924, finney's `TaggedTransactionQueue_validate_transaction` rejects an extrinsic built from vector 1 and the app's signature with `Payment` (the test key has no funds), and with `BadProof` once one signature bit is flipped. So the signed payload, metadata digest included, matches what the spec 477 runtime checks.

## Emulator

`add_stake` of 1 TAO (vector 1), signed on Speculos v0.27.1 with ELFs built from `main` and from this branch with ledger-app-builder-lite (`make COIN=DOT PRODUCTION_BUILD=1`). Only nanosp and flex were run. The `amount_staked` screen, title and value, is the same on both devices:

```
main:         amount_staked  1000000000
this branch:  amount_staked  TAO 1.0
```

Every other screen is pixel-identical between the two builds. The signature is the same in all four runs (`009bb38a...220a`) and verifies against the device's ed25519 key. All five targets (nanox, nanosp, stax, flex, apex_p) also build with the builder image pinned in `deps/ledger-zxlib/dockerized_build.mk` (`zondax/ledger-app-builder:ledger-abf331c8...`).

## Version and snapshots

I did not bump `APPVERSION_P`, so `ledger-check-version` will fail (tag `v100.0.29` exists). The bump has to land before or with the merge, since a push to `main` uploads the installers to the release named after the version. It also changes seven main-menu snapshots (`{x,sp,st,fl,ap}-mainmenu/00004.png`, `{x,sp}-mainmenu/00010.png`). I can't render those, or a zemu test like the one #272 added for #231, in a way I can check against your CI, so this PR only adds C++ vectors. Do you want the bump in this PR? Maintainer edits are enabled, or I can push it along with the seven PNGs from the `snapshots-tmp` artifact of the `test_zemu` job.
title: fix: format TaoBalance amounts as native balances
